summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 63 (read-chain navigation and rotation core) of the CipherBox project, then ship it via the GSD workflow.
summary.outcome: Planning completed through the full GSD pipeline (research → pattern mapping → planning → verification). 7 plans across 4 waves were produced and committed. Verification found 1 blocker and 2 warnings, all fixed directly (no replanning needed). Execution and ship-phase were not reached in this transcript.

repo: Phase 63 covers sdk-core backend crypto (no UI/frontend component); UI gate is skipped for this phase.
GSD config for this project: researcher=sonnet, planner=opus, checker=sonnet; research+plan_check+nyquist+pattern_mapper all enabled.
The CI health poll pattern for the API uses `curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/health` against port 3000 with `/health` endpoint — this is the canonical robust startup wait used across CI scripts.
Commit signing was already disabled at the repo level (`commit.gpgsign: false`); no action needed for unattended runs.
The codebase map in `.planning/codebase/` flags as stale (non-blocking at plan time) — CONTEXT.md + RESEARCH.md carry authoritative current implementation-site references.

GSD commit helper emits a known false-positive warning ('needs human verification') when `previous_status: human_needed` appears in frontmatter history — verified via git log to confirm commit actually landed.

code.finding: Plan originally used fragile `sleep 12` for API startup wait; replaced with bounded health-poll loop mirroring CI's `curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/health` pattern.
Open Questions section must be renamed and marked RESOLVED after planning; leaving it unresolved triggers a blocker in the plan-checker gate.
VALIDATION.md per-task map is left as a template stub during step 5.5 and must be filled in after planning (post-planner, pre-checker-iteration-2) with actual task IDs and automated verify commands.

workflow: GSD plan-phase blocker fixes that are deterministic (formatting, tracking markers, fragile shell commands) can be applied directly by the orchestrator without re-spawning the planner, then the checker is re-run independently to keep the gate honest.
Pattern mapper outputs a 10-analog PATTERNS.md that the planner commits alongside the plan files; PATTERNS.md starts as untracked and is committed in the planner's artifact commit.
API-SURFACE regeneration returning 0 symbols is expected for a phase whose scope is entirely new code (no existing exported symbols to surface); omit it from the planner prompt in that case.
When running the full GSD pipeline unattended (user AFK), verify commit signing is off at repo level before starting to prevent biometric prompts from hanging subagents.

friction: GSD commit helper emits a false-positive 'needs human verification' warning when `previous_status: human_needed` is in frontmatter history, requiring a manual `git log` confirmation that commits actually landed.
VALIDATION.md per-task map must be manually filled post-planning; the step 5.5 template stub is insufficient for the checker and causes a WARNING finding on the first verification pass.
RESEARCH.md Open Questions section triggers a checker BLOCKER if not explicitly marked RESOLVED after planning, even when the questions are substantively answered in the body.
Codebase map in `.planning/codebase/` was stale and flagged by the drift gate, adding noise even though it was non-blocking and irrelevant to this phase's scope.
open_items: Execution of Phase 63 (wave-based implementation) was not started in this session — only planning completed.
`/ship-phase 63` (PR creation, review, merge prep) was not reached.
